rows: Drop-off at a certified recycler or collection centre
Bengaluruardi options listed in the search results include RecycleKaro’s Bengaluru facility, Saahas, Croma stores, and other listed recyclers/collection points that accept batteries.[9]
RecycleKaro and EcoFly both describe pickup services, and Zolopik also offers pickup for battery/e-waste collection in Bengaluru Bengaluru.[7110]
Some brands and authorised partners offer battery/e-waste return programs, including brand-linked collection or pickup arrangements.[5]
